CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Date_of_Birth__c), NULL, YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Date_of_Birth__c) - IF(OR(MONTH(TODAY()) < MONTH(Date_of_Birth__c), AND(MONTH(TODAY()) = MONTH(Date_of_Birth__c), DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(Date_of_Birth__c))), 1, 0))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Completed years, calculated from Date of Birth. Blank when Date of Birth is blank.
CustomField.label: Age
